alcance: Sólo COUNT de disponibilidad Norte, sin filtro textual; 100000 obras

anterior_correlacionada.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM obra o JOIN edicion ep ON ep.id = COALESCE(o.edicion_preferida_id,
            (SELECT id FROM edicion WHERE obra_id = o.id AND idioma = 'spa' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1))
            AND ep.obra_id = o.id AND ep.idioma = 'spa' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obra_autor oa WHERE oa.obra_id = o.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edicion d JOIN ejemplar e ON e.edicion_id = d.id
            JOIN sede s ON s.id = e.sede_actual_id
            WHERE d.obra_id = o.id AND e.situacion_operativa = 'LIBRE'
                AND e.condicion_fisica = 'APTO' AND e.sede_actual_id = e.sede_propietaria_id
                AND s.activa = 1 AND e.sede_actual_id = '077350a5-2867-5c24-81ce-d27c6a4cd78c')
